item.description: A new CEN Workshop is being planned as part of the activities of the EU project 'Caring Nature'. item.title: The updated CEN-CENELEC Guide 36 is now available
item.description: CEN and CENELEC have published the revised CEN-CENELEC Guide 36,‘Guidance on the rules for the drafting and presentation of candidate performance harmonized standards in support of Regulation (EU) 2024/3110 Construction Products Regulation CPR-2024’, following its approval by the CEN and CENELEC Technical Boards. The Guide is intended for Technical Committees developing candidate performance harmonized European Standards for construction products. It provides guidance on the drafting and presentation of standards developed in response to a standardization request issued under Regulation (EU) 2024/3110 (CPR-2024), in accordance with Article 5 of the Regulation. item.title: Draft CWA for comment: 'Green and Circular Healthcare Buildings: Circularity, Energy, and Wellbeing'
item.description: A new CEN Workshop is being planned as part of the activities of the EU project 'Caring Nature'. This project focuses its energies on reducing the carbon footprint of the healthcare sector. This is no small task, and many innovative solutions are needed that consider the safety and health of both patients and operators. In the area of healthcare buildings, there is a current lack of standardized principles and guidelines for circularity and green practices. At the same time there is growing demand for healthcare infrastructure that is environmentally sustainable. To meet this challenge, a CEN Workshop has been proposed. The Workshop is tasked with helping to develop a Green Circular Compass – a tool which will take into account several areas, including circularity, energy, and well-being.

item.title: European Agile Specifications: a new step in modernizing European standardization
item.description: European standardization is evolving. New technologies, changing regulatory and market needs and increasingly digital ways of working require a system that can respond faster, while safeguarding the quality, consensus, openness and trust on which it is built. Against this backdrop, CEN and CENELEC have approved the European Agile Specification (EAS) – a new standardization deliverable designed to bring trusted technical solutions to market more quicky. The decision represents another concrete step in CEN and CENELEC’s ongoing work to modernize the European Standardization System and make it more responsive. item.title: Keeping Drones Within Safe Boundaries: Three European Standards for Safer Flights
item.description: As unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), commonly known as drones, become more common in European skies, a question arises: how can we ensure that these aircraft remain within authorized areas and can be brought safely to the ground when something goes wrong? This matters especially near airports, restricted zones and densely populated areas, where an unexpected flight path may endanger people. Three European Standards—EN 4709-003:2026, EN 4709-005:2026 and EN 4709-006:2026—address this challenge. Developed by CEN/TC 471 ‘Unmanned Aircraft Systems’, they offer complementary requirements and verification methods, from anticipating airspace infringement to containing an aircraft and, as a last resort, terminating its flight. item.title: Not your standard magazine
item.description: A0 for architectural plans, C1 for oversized certificates and DL (DIN long) for the longest sentence in German literature: there are standards behind the formats we use every day. To show that standards can also inspire creativity, DIN created a magazine with a twist: 45 pages in 45 different paper sizes. Each page features a unique interpretation of its paper size, brought to life by artists, designers and other creative minds. The unusual concept has also caught the attention of the creative industry, winning several awards, including a Bronze Lion at the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. Watch the video to discover the magazine in all its formats. TAGS: Newsletter On the spot Members

item.title: CEN and CENELEC Activities
item.description: We are pleased to inform you about the upcoming CEN and CENELEC activities in 2026. 3 November – RISERS Conference – How can Europe drive cross-sectoral resource efficiency? Upscaling industrial symbiosis through standardization The conference will bring together representatives of industry, research, policymaking and standardization to discuss how Europe can accelerate the implementation of industrial symbiosis across sectors. The event will present the key results of the RISERS project, including the Industrial Symbiosis Standardization Roadmap, and explore the role of standards in bridging innovation and market deployment, supporting European policy objectives and reducing barriers to industrial collaboration.
